source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The visible message text is Unicode. The inline OpenPGP processing boundary expects bytes in the message charset, so convertFromUnicode runs for UTF-8 as well as other charsets. After processing, byteStringToString converts the final text back for display. Skipping the UTF-8 conversion produced damaged accented text when the signing key was unknown. Keep the representation and charset at both boundaries explicit. Raw fixture bytes and both encoding cases were inspected, without decrypting or verifying a fixture independently.
title: Convert inline OpenPGP text to bytes even when the charset is UTF-8
